note: Controls test whether judges can tell a claim the ledger supports from one it does not, including changed numbers and swapped mechanisms. Planted claims are hidden among a real brief's claims to measure detection at real scale. Fabricated ones name products or figures no plan here uses. Distorted ones use ordinary words to state what a plan should not, such as a reversed decision. They are skipped for any ledger containing one of their markers. One author wrote all of this.

Merge concurrent note bodies with the Yjs text CRDT.
